record.issue_text: app/assets/javascripts/admin/components/embeddable-host.js.es6:38 sets category from Discourse.Category.findById(categoryId) after save, but when categoryId is null the server substituted uncategorized_category_id, so the UI shows no category until reload

adjudication.rationale: In `embeddable-host`’s `save()` action, the client sends `props.category_id = this.get('categoryId')`. For a new host `categoryId` starts as `null` (it is only set in `edit()` from `host.category.id`, and new records have no category). On the server, `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#save_host` explicitly substitutes `SiteSetting.uncategorized_category_id` when `category_id` is blank. However, after a successful save the UI sets `host.category = Discourse.Category.findById(this.get('categoryId'))`; if `categoryId` was `null`, this assigns `undefined` even though the server just saved/returned a non-null `category_id`. Because the serializer only returns `category_id` (not an embedded category object), `host.category` won’t be auto-hydrated, so the category badge can be empty until reload.
